pois.name: Sample 15: Mageik
pois.description: Sample 15 of the NASA Perseverance sample list: core/sample 'Mageik' from feature 'Amalik', sealed sol 619 (Nov. 16, 2022). Rock type per NASA list: Sedimentary (Rock Core). Sampling region per NASA list: Delta Front. APPROXIMATE position derived from the rover waypoint at sol 609 (RMC 30_1172, MMGIS waypoint, the last waypoint at or before sol 619); NOT an official sample coordinate. The rover may have moved between that waypoint and coring; the chord to the next waypoint (sol 629) is 43 m, so treat the position as uncertain by at least 43 m. In-situ mineral statement (olivine; tier confirmed_in_situ marked within 43 m): Williams et al. 2023, LPSC 54 abstract (NTRS 20230000588): at Cape Nukshak 'primary mineral phases (olivine, pyroxenes) were detected by SCAM LIBS and VISIR'; Amalik is the location of cores Shuyak and Mageik. Hurowitz et al. 2023 (Goldschmidt, doi:10.7185/gold2023.18487): PIXL finds an 'altered olivine-dominated' source at the base of the Cape Nukshak section (Amalik member). Section-level statements applied at the sample site; no per-sample mineralogy was read. Williams et al. 2023 also report VISIR signatures at Amalik most consistent with a Mg-rich serpentine; serpentine is not an evidence layer here.
